# Security policy

**Sentio One** is a fork of [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent). This file applies to the code in this repository.

## Reporting a vulnerability in Sentio One

Report privately through GitHub: **Security > Report a vulnerability** on this repository. Please do not open a public issue.

This covers what the fork adds: per-user profile access control, invite links, the admin Access page, the per-company deployment
(`deploy/`), the sandbox, and the desktop client's connect flow. Include what you did, what you expected, what happened, and the
commit you tested.

## Reporting a vulnerability in Hermes Agent itself

If the flaw is in code that comes from upstream and is not changed by this fork, report it to Nous Research following
[their policy](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/main/SECURITY.md), not here. If you are not sure, report it here and
we will route it.
